messages:
marta: Quick update — ran an AWQ+GPTQ hybrid run with SmoothQuant act-aware preprocessing on the 13B longctx 80k suite. Short summary: instr-follow F1 down 0.9% vs fp16, PPL +1.6, latency down ~28% at token level. act-aware scaling on FF layers seems to help tail stability but needs tuning.

kevin: Nice. can you paste the eval table and the exact config you used? where is the regression coming from?

marta: Paste of the main table (quick, truncated):
```
Model         | PPL  | Instr-F1 | AvgLat(ms)
fp16          | 12.1 | 0.812    | 120
AWQ+GPTQ(hyb) | 12.3 | 0.804    | 86
AWQ-only      | 12.5 | 0.798    | 80
```
ActNorm tweak (+act-aware preproc) recovered ~+0.3 Instr-F1 for the hybrid. Command I used: `python tools/quantize.py --model 13B --method awq_gptq --actnorm --calib 2000 --longctx 80000`

ashwin: Any kv-cache correctness issues at 80k? eviction artifacts or reconstruction mismatch?

marta: Ran kv-checker across 2k sample prefixes: mismatch rate ~0.08% (mostly in very long chain reasoning prompts). Most signal points to activation drift in first 4 FF layers causing early divergence. I put sample diffs in the internal gist: https://internal.gist/r/quant-diffs-1746000123 (private).

sara: For rollout proposal: canary on Dedicated pool only (so we control cache warmup), with gating: Instr-F1 delta <= 0.5% AND PPL delta <= 2.0 AND KV-mismatch <= 0.2%. p99 latency must remain <150ms. Fallback path -> fp16 shard variant. Also require 4h steady-state with synthetic longctx traffic.

deploy-bot: Canary created: `redwood-canary-quant-1746000123` scheduled 2024-10-02 09:30 UTC :rocket:

marta: Assigning @kevin to own the canary dashboard/alerts, @ashwin to add actnorm calibration step into the quant pipeline and publish the calibration artifact. I'll open a PR with the exact act-scale params and include the sample diffs.

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll wire alerts (Instr-F1 delta > 0.5% OR kv-mismatch > 0.2%) and add a small synthetic suite that exercises chained reasoning.

ashwin: Quick note from local perf runs: ActScale multiplier = 0.95 on layers 0..3 reduced drift noticeably. Also try increasing calib samples to 4k for hybrid — small cost, better stability.

marta: Good calls. We'll aim to run the canary tomorrow, keep this thread for post-canary notes.
